response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acct_avg) AS figure FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS all_avg FROM reg), above AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.all_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS a_avg FROM above) SELECT ab.region, ab.figure, ab.figure - o.all_avg AS excess_over_all_region_avg, ab.figure / aa.a_avg AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above ab CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN above_avg aa ORDER BY ab.figure DESC;

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is averaged as stored (unsigned), with no sign adjustment by trans.type, since the request says to average trans.amount.
Accounts with no transactions have no per-account average and are left out of the regional averages.
The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures, not weighted by account count.
